name: Vellar (Southern)

source.name: Confluence of the Anaimaduvu and Kallar streams, near Ramanathapuram village, Vazhapadi taluk

sink.name: Near Parangipettai (Porto Novo)
sink.location: Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu, Bay of Bengal

significance: historic Porto Novo trading port at its mouth
did_you_know: This Salem-to-Cuddalore Vellar is a distinct river from at least one other Tamil Nadu river also called Vellar; the spec disambiguates it as 'Vellar (Southern)' to avoid confusion between them.
It reaches the coast near Parangipettai, historically known as Porto Novo, once a significant Danish and later British trading port.
The Gomukhi, Manimuktha and Swetha reservoirs along its tributaries make it one of the more heavily dammed medium-sized rivers in northern Tamil Nadu.
